learning_objective: 🎯 Take a deep breath! Today we will learn simple Yoga habits to help our bodies stretch and our minds relax.

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Sit with a straight back. Breathe in slowly through your nose like smelling a sweet flower, and breathe out slowly from your mouth.
When you wake up, reach your hands high up to the sky to stretch your body. It makes you feel fresh and energetic!

fun_activity.title: 🌟 Starfish Breathing
fun_activity.instructions: Open your hand like a starfish. Use your other finger to trace up and down your fingers, breathing in as you go up, and out as you go down.

quick_recap: ⭐ Deep breathing helps calm our minds when we feel angry or tired.
⭐ Doing simple stretches every day keeps our muscles strong and flexible.
